// ADR-284 §7a acceptance set — photos rebuilt in the builder, generated by packages/shared/src/codeView/generate.ts.
// Golden output of apps/builder/src/preview/catalog/__tests__/adr284CodeView.test.tsx (UPDATE_CODE_VIEW=1 rewrites).

import {useState} from 'react';
import {GridList, GridListItem, Tree, TreeItem} from 'react-aria-components';
import {useListData} from 'react-aria-components/useListData';
import {isTextDropItem, useDragAndDrop} from 'react-aria-components/useDragAndDrop';
import albums from './data/albums';
import photosData from './data/photos';

export default function Home() {
  let [album, setAlbum] = useState('library');
  let photos = useListData({
    initialItems: photosData,
    getKey: item => item.id
  });
  let photosView = photos.items
    .filter(item =>
      (album === 'library' || item.album === album));
  let {dragAndDropHooks: treeDragAndDrop} = useDragAndDrop({
    acceptedDragTypes: ['photos'],
    getDropOperation: () => 'move',
    async onItemDrop(e) {
      let keys = await Promise.all(e.items.filter(isTextDropItem).map(item => item.getText('photos')));
      for (let id of keys) photos.update(id, {...photos.getItem(id), album: e.target.key});
      setAlbum(e.target.key);
    },
  });
  let {dragAndDropHooks: gridListDragAndDrop} = useDragAndDrop({
    getItems: keys => [...keys].map(key => ({'photos': String(key)})),
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Tree selectionMode="single" selectedKeys={[album]} onSelectionChange={(keys) => {
        setAlbum([...keys][0] ?? '');
      }} dragAndDropHooks={treeDragAndDrop} items={albums}>
        {item => <TreeItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</TreeItem>}
      </Tree>
      <GridList dragAndDropHooks={gridListDragAndDrop} items={photosView}>
        {item => <GridListItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</GridListItem>}
      </GridList>
    </>
  );
}
